answer: Sybil resistance couples EigenTrust matrix factorization with exponential temporal decay: reputation loses half its weight each fixed half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocal honest service across the evaluation horizon to accumulate centrality. A freshly spawned sybil begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted endorsements and reciprocity-weighted transitivity, its score cannot reach the consensus threshold, whether hidden in velvet coordination or a nebula of aliases.
